name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: Cornell Health Lower Extremity Strengthening Protocol

steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, about hip-width apart.
Extend one leg straight out in line with your opposite thigh, or bend it toward your chest.
Press firmly down through the heel of your grounded foot and squeeze your glute to lift your hips off the mat.
Lift until your body forms a straight line from your grounded knee through your hips to your shoulder.
Pause at the top for one second with your hips level, then slowly lower back to the mat.
coaching_cues: Do not allow your pelvis to drop or rotate toward the non-working side.
Drive purely through the heel of the working leg to maximize glute contraction.
Keep your neck and upper shoulders relaxed on the mat.

sources.attribution: Cornell Health Lower Extremity Strengthening Protocol
